source.author: ov
source.text: Plena patris thalamis excedit et impia diro semina fert utero conceptaque crimina portat.
source.text_original: Plena patris thalamis excedit et impia diro / semina fert utero conceptaque crimina portat.
source.text_english: She leaves her father’s chamber full, and, impious, bears the dreadful seed in her womb and carries the crimes she has conceived.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: nec timet Ancaeum genetrix committere ponto, plena tulit quem rege maris.
reuse.text_original: nec timet Ancaeum genetrix committere ponto, / plena tulit quem rege maris.
reuse.text_english: nor does his mother fear to entrust Ancaeus to the sea, she who had borne him, full, by the sea-king.
